text: The lab sets LAMBDA_MAX = 0.906 for the Lorenz system at dt = 0.02. Roughly how long is one Lyapunov time, expressed in both physical time and integration steps?
explanation: tau_L = 1/lambda_max = 1/0.906 ~ 1.10 time units; at dt=0.02 that is ~55 integration steps (LYAPUNOV_STEPS in the lab). Option 0 is merely dt; option 1 wrongly multiplies by lambda_max instead of inverting it; option 2 is arbitrary.
